verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure: the headline, divider, subhead and chevron are spaced the same way in the panel. Its main flaw is one it inherits from the original: 'YOU WANT' pushes right up to the panel's right edge. B has a clear collision: the divider rule cuts across the baseline of 'YOU' in the headline. It also leaves a large dead gap before the subhead, which makes the panel's spacing uneven.
